text:
Maria: FYI customer reported being billed twice for single inference calls and seeing large tail latencies. They say hedged requests are firing to a different region and both requests completed.
Sam: can you paste repro steps + SDK config? which SDK version?
Maria: repro steps below, minimal:
```
// client config
{\n  hedgedRequests: true,\n  maxHedgeAttempts: 2,\n  connectTimeoutMs: 200,\n  readTimeoutMs: 1500,\n  regionFallbackPolicy: 'closest',\n  preferLocalRegion: false\n}\n// call: client.generate({ model: 'rw-large', prompt: 'hello' })
```
They sent logs showing two requests with same user trace id hitting us-east-1 and eu-west-1 within 300ms.
Sam: version? older SDKs had hedging default on for some workloads. if connect timeout too low client fires hedge quickly.
Ying: confirming: hedged requests by design will send concurrent requests to primary+fallback. billing-side we count each successful token stream as billable, so customer is getting charged for both completions. we need to block cross-region hedges for this account asap.
Noah: immediate mitigation: ask customer to set `hedgedRequests=false` and `preferLocalRegion=true` in their SDK config. we can also set an account-level override.
Priya: can you share the request ids so we can correlate in routing logs?
Maria: sample trace ids: req_6a1f3b and req_6a1f3b-dup. Server routing log snippet:
```
2026-03-12T16:22:10Z INFO route request_id=req_6a1f3b region=us-east-1 route=primary node=gpux-11
2026-03-12T16:22:10Z INFO route request_id=req_6a1f3b region=eu-west-1 route=fallback node=gpu-eu-3
2026-03-12T16:22:10Z INFO response request_id=req_6a1f3b bytes=12345 status=200 tokens=42
2026-03-12T16:22:10Z INFO response request_id=req_6a1f3b-dup bytes=12290 status=200 tokens=42
```
Ying: root cause hypothesis: aggressive connectTimeout (200ms) + hedging enabled + regionFallbackPolicy that prefers "closest" but allows cross-region when primary slow. jitter/backoff makes client flip to other region quickly. hedgedRequests multiplies the problem because both succeed and we bill both.
Sam: proposed SDK change: (1) respect server region-affinity header before hedging, (2) do not hedge across region boundary by default (opt-in), (3) increase default connectTimeout to 500ms and avoid firing hedges until RTT estimate + safety margin. will open PR for hotfix.
Noah: quick ops mitigation I can push now: account override to force hedgedRequests=false for Brightleaf and set preferLocalRegion=true. Also adding a temporary routing rule to drop fallback hedges across regions for that tenant.
Priya: will that affect latency SLAs? might see slight tail increase but avoids double billing. ok from support side if we notify customer.
Maria: customer wants a short note to confirm we disabled cross-region hedging and that we recommend SDK update. I'll send regression steps to them.
ops-bot: ticket RWF-4021 created, canary rollout scheduled for SDK patch (sha: be9f3a) at 2026-03-14T01:00:00Z.
Ying: long-term: add server-side dedupe for idempotent inference requests (idempotency-key header) and an accounting change to bill only the fastest completed shard when hedge used within Xms across regions. engineering will evaluate impact.
Sam: I'll include tests for region-affinity and hedging limits in the PR.
Noah: deploying account override now, will update when done.
Maria: thanks — please ping me when the override is live so I can update the customer. :thumbsup:
